ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions occupy the lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle base into the inner lobes. Punctate dark spots are distributed across the lower quadrant of the left lobe. Dark pigment bordering the trailing edge and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated 75-80 degree aperture and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude irregularities at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-curvilinear sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight posterior-lateral curve towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast, high-relief pixel aggregates on the terminal ends of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical low-intensity linear mark on the right lobe near the notch, and a thin curved dark line on the lower-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization and resulting calcified texture at the fluke extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized brown/yellow pixel staining observed on the trailing edge and tip of the right lobe.
